new_candidates.date_enacted: June 1, 2026 (County Council third reading and public hearing, adopting Ordinance 25-26-23)
new_candidates.duration: Until January 1, 2028, or until the county adopts regulations for data center/data processing/cryptocurrency mining uses, whichever occurs first
new_candidates.trigger: Immediately stops acceptance, review, or action on zoning approvals, construction permits, site plans, and other county approvals for data centers, data processing facilities, cryptocurrency mining operations, and related uses in unincorporated Chesterfield County; followed an emergency moratorium adopted April 6, 2026.
new_candidates.current_status: Active as of 2026-07-31; regular ordinance replacing an April 6, 2026 emergency moratorium, in effect until 2028-01-01 or earlier adoption of permanent regulations.
new_candidates.outcome: Adopted long-term temporary moratorium on data center and related approvals in unincorporated Chesterfield County.

evidence.supports: Full ordinance text establishing third-reading adoption, scope, and the January 1, 2028 (or earlier-regulation) end condition.

new_candidates.notes: The April 6, 2026 emergency moratorium predates this research window and is not separately submitted; only the June 1, 2026 regular ordinance is submitted as the candidate instrument. Not previously in the inventory.

new_candidates.date_enacted: July 6, 2026 (County Council third reading and enactment of Ordinance 26-O-04, effective immediately)
new_candidates.trigger: Pauses consideration of special exceptions, conditional uses, and other land-use approvals for data centers while county staff and the Planning Commission study appropriate locations/conditions and prepare comprehensive-plan and code amendments; also holds received-but-unconsidered applications in abeyance.
new_candidates.current_status: Active as of 2026-07-31; the Southern Environmental Law Center agreed to pause related litigation for the moratorium period.
new_candidates.affected_projects: Unspecified data center project(s) subject to related Southern Environmental Law Center litigation, paused during the moratorium.
new_candidates.outcome: Adopted six-month moratorium on data center special exceptions/conditional uses.

evidence.supports: Signed ordinance recording third-reading enactment, six-month term, and scope.
Confirms enactment and reports the related litigation pause.

new_candidates.notes: Progressed through first reading (2026-05-04) and second reading (2026-06-01) before third-reading enactment on 2026-07-06; only the enacted instrument is submitted as a candidate. Not previously in the inventory.

new_candidates.date_enacted: July 13, 2026 (County Council third reading and public hearing, effective immediately in unincorporated York County)
new_candidates.legal_basis: York County Council moratorium ordinance on data centers; ordinance number not located in sources reviewed
new_candidates.trigger: Restricts special-exception and conditional-use approvals, site-plan acceptance, and other land-use/development approvals for data centers in unincorporated York County while the county studies utility, water, noise, pollution, infrastructure, and nearby-property impacts.
new_candidates.current_status: Active as of 2026-07-31; may be extended by resolution if more study time is needed. Applies only in unincorporated areas; vested projects, including approved QTS site plans, are exempt.
new_candidates.affected_projects: Existing vested projects, including approved QTS site plans, are exempt from the moratorium.
new_candidates.outcome: Adopted nine-month moratorium on data center land-use approvals in unincorporated York County.

evidence.supports: Agenda packet with ordinance text recording third-reading adoption and its scope.
County data center page confirming third-reading adoption on July 13, 2026 and the exemption for vested projects.

new_candidates.notes: Progressed through first reading (2026-06-15) and second reading (2026-06-29) before third-reading enactment on 2026-07-13; only the enacted instrument is submitted as a candidate. Not previously in the inventory.
